Markets.title: Why is market crashing today? Sensex slumps 800 points, Nifty below 22,350. 5 key factors behind Rs 8 lakh crore wipeout
Markets.summary: The Indian stock market crashed today, with the Sensex plunging 800 points and the Nifty falling below 22,350. This downturn caused an Rs 8 lakh crore investor wealth wipeout, driven by heavy foreign institutional selling, rising bond yields, and a weaker rupee.

Markets.title: Moneyview shares skyrocket 82% from IPO price after strong market debut. Should you buy, sell or hold?
Markets.summary: Moneyview shares surged 82% from their Rs 34 IPO price to reach Rs 62 on Thursday following a strong market debut on the BSE. Investors are now weighing whether to buy, sell, or hold the stock after its significant first-day gains.

Markets.title: Why is Liquidia stock plunging? Yutrepia patent case explained
Markets.summary: Liquidia shares dropped nearly 50% after a U.S. court ruled in favor of United Therapeutics in a patent dispute. This legal loss threatens the commercial success of Liquidia's drug, Yutrepia.

Markets.title: US Market: 10-year yield surges to 5.31%, highest since 2007
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields surged to their highest levels since 2007, with the 10-year yield hitting 5.31% during a historic bond selloff. This market pressure was driven by persistent inflation, rising energy costs, strong AI investment, and changing Federal Reserve expectations.

Markets.title: Highway Infrastructure shares jump 9% after Rs 245 crore toll operations win from UP authority, NHAI
Markets.summary: Highway Infrastructure shares jumped 9% after winning toll operations orders worth Rs 254 crore from UPEIDA and NHAI. The largest order, valued at Rs 220.66 crore, covers toll collection and plaza operations on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway.

Markets.title: $2 billion gone in two days! FIIs accelerate selling as Nifty, Sensex set to fall for 8th week running. Will they make a comeback?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors pulled over Rs 20,000 crore from Indian equities in two sessions amid rising crude prices and US bond yields. This massive outflow has pushed the Nifty and Sensex toward an eighth consecutive weekly decline.

Data & Insights.title: September GST collections cross  ₹2 trillion again
Data & Insights.summary: September GST collections rose 14.7% to ₹2.04 trillion, crossing the ₹2 trillion mark again. Import-linked revenue grew nearly 26% and accounted for more than half of the total increase.

Data & Insights.summary: Crisil states that a potential 0.50 percentage point RBI rate hike and weak monsoon rains will have minimal impact on India Inc.'s stable corporate credit quality. However, diamond, specialty chemicals, and polyester textiles businesses face risks from ongoing geopolitical conflicts.

Data & Insights.title: Govt keeps small savings rates unchanged for December quarter
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has kept interest rates on all small savings schemes unchanged for the eleventh consecutive quarter. Despite rising bond yields, the Centre is relying on steady collections from these programs to help fund its fiscal deficit.

Data & Insights.title: India's fiscal deficit widens to  ₹7.1 lakh crore, hits 41.9% of FY27 target by August
Data & Insights.summary: India's fiscal deficit widened to ₹7.1 lakh crore by August, reaching 41.9% of the government's full-year target of ₹16.96 lakh crore for FY27. This is higher than the 38.1% deficit recorded during the same period in the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: Indian economy fares better in August but renewed worries linger
Data & Insights.summary: India's economy improved in August due to stronger vehicle sales, credit growth, a resilient rupee, and a reduced trade deficit. However, new geopolitical risks threaten to slow this economic momentum.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China's agreement to purchase 10 million tonnes of US coal provides a new export market for American miners. This trade concession helps Beijing secure leverage in broader trade negotiations with Washington.

India.summary: SpiceJet CEO praised Captain Smit Machchhar, who previously worked for SpiceJet, after he was seriously injured by his co-pilot. The Omani co-pilot stabbed Machchhar during a flydubai flight traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv.

India.title: Top Court Dismisses Trinamool's Plea To Operate 4 Debit-Frozen Bank Accounts
India.summary: The Supreme Court dismissed the Trinamool Congress's plea to operate four debit-frozen bank accounts. The court noted that because the Election Commission has frozen the party's symbol, the larger issue of who is entitled to the funds remains pending adjudication.

India.title: From 42,000 To 45 Lakh: In 70 Years, Applications To UPSC Exams Grow More Than 100 Times
India.summary: Over the past 70 years, annual applications for UPSC examinations have surged over 100 times, growing from 42,000 to 45 lakh. Additionally, official records from 1949 to 1951 show that only one woman was selected for the Indian Foreign Service and two for the IAS.
